title: Fetching Data
description: Learn patterns for fetching data from APIs in React.

data.text: Data fetching is one of the most common side effects in React. Let's explore patterns for loading, caching, and displaying data from APIs.

data.title: Fetch on Mount

data.text: Use AbortController to cancel fetch requests when the component unmounts to prevent state updates on unmounted components.

data.title: Abort Controller
Fetch on Change
Consider Data Fetching Libraries
data.text: For production apps, consider React Query or SWR. They handle caching, refetching, and error handling automatically.

points: Fetch data in useEffect with empty dependency array
